# 🧠 Researcher \| Data Analyst \| Peacebuilding Practitioner

I am a political scientist and mixed-methods researcher focused on understanding how violence, institutional trust, and collective action evolve in conflict-affected contexts—especially in rural Colombia. My work brings together spatial analysis, survey data, and qualitative research to unpack complex political and social phenomena and inform policy and practice.

My doctoral dissertation examines how **agricultural cooperatives and peasant associations contribute to violence prevention and peacebuilding** in Colombia’s PDET municipalities. Grounded in theories of civilian agency and the social and solidarity economy, I use municipal-level quantitative data and thematic analysis of testimonies to reveal how bottom-up economic initiatives shape community resilience.

But this interest in understanding conflict from below did not begin with my PhD.

Early in my research career, I authored *La Violencia en el Magdalena Medio: Análisis de la Dinámica Espacial* (Uniandes, 2010), a book that used **spatial and quantitative methods** to analyze how organized armed groups strategically shaped the geography of violence. That work demonstrated a close relationship between the presence of armed actors and shifts in local violence, challenging simplistic narratives that framed violence as random or purely “everyday.”

Since then, I have expanded my methodological toolkit to include: - Quasi-experimental designs - Index construction and mixed indicators - Reflexive thematic analysis - Natural Language Processing (NLP) for event text mining

My guiding question remains: **how can data—both numerical and narrative—help us understand conflict and build more just and peaceful societies?**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 💼 Consultancy & Applied Research

Alongside academic research, I work as a consultant designing and analyzing data-driven peacebuilding tools.

At **Fundación Ideas para la Paz (FIP)**, I have led and contributed to several projects focused on the intersection of **business, trust, and peacebuilding**, including:

-   **"Empresarios y Paz" (2021–2023)**: A comparative analysis of how Colombian companies perceive and engage with ex-combatants, migrants, and victims.
-   **"Confianza Territorial"**: Mixed-method tools to evaluate trust and institutional performance at the local level.
-   **"Gestión frente a Alertas Tempranas"**: Indicator development to assess government responses to conflict risk and prevention.
-   📖 *See also:* ["Medir con enfoque mixto mejora la construcción de paz"](https://www.lasillavacia.com/red-de-expertos/red-de-la-paz/medir-con-enfoque-mixto-mejora-la-construccion-de-paz/)

I am especially interested in bridging the gap between quantitative rigor and qualitative depth through hybrid measurement tools.

# 📂 Projects & Interests

My current portfolio includes:

-   [**Cooperatives and Peacebuilding**](projects/cooperatives.qmd)\
    Municipal-level statistical analysis + thematic testimony coding on economic alternatives in Sur del Tolima

-   [**ACLED Conflict Trends**](projects/acled.qmd)\
    NLP-based analysis of violence reports in Latin America (2018–2024), using tokenization and word frequencies

-   [**Business and Inclusion**](projects/business.qmd)\
    Analysis of employer attitudes in Colombia toward hiring vulnerable populations (survey data 2021 & 2023)

# 🧭 Practitioner & Legacy

I co-founded **MAPEA**, a consulting and research initiative I built with my father, whose legacy continues to shape my professional path. MAPEA supports institutions working on reintegration, rural development, and post-conflict recovery. Our mission is rooted in meaningful, evidence-based contributions to peacebuilding and territorial governance.
